g.text: Combine the intervals covered by results allowed under one rule set.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Starting at the current beat, measure how far that coverage continues

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: without a hole. Stop at the first missing interval.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Union combines intervals; subset means every beat is covered; sup gives longest lead.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: I_a: covered interval; class: allowed-output rules; beta_play: current beat; H: ready beats.
